notes: Manufacturer authoritative source: SMART Board GX (V3) series spec sheet (docs.smarttech.com/kb/171902), which covers the 65"/75"/86" family; port configuration (front/rear I/O) is identical across all three sizes per the sheet's combined table. The 86" model is sold as GX086-V3 (no embedded OS) or GX186-V3/order code (with embedded OS) - this entry covers physical I/O which is the same for both variants. RJ45 grade (eth-1g) inferred from "1000BASE-T" stated in the Connectivity section, not the I/O table itself. Power connector type (IEC) is inferred from "country-specific power cable" wording plus standard large-format-display practice; the spec sheet does not explicitly name the inlet connector. OPS PC accessory slot (rear) exists but is omitted as it is a computing module bay, not a signal/power connector in this schema. VESA mount is 800x600mm (M8); this is a desktop/wall-mount unit so rackUnits is omitted. USB Type-B ports are touch-interface pass-through links to a connected host PC (used for the interactive touch return channel), not general host ports; still connector-typed usb-b/bidirectional per schema convention.
